verdict.rationale: An llms.txt exists at the vendor's corporate domain (freshworks.com/llms.txt) and includes product feature content such as Gmail/Outlook sync, so there is some agent-oriented entry point. Probes show the Freshsales developer docs have no llms.txt, no markdown doc variant and no OpenAPI spec at any candidate path, so the API docs themselves are not agent-oriented. Missing for 10: llms.txt on the developer/API docs site, markdown-rendered docs, machine-readable OpenAPI spec, evidence the llms.txt covers API/developer content, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
